meta.title: 我的新邻居来自英国
meta.titleEn: My new neighbors come from the UK
meta.topic: 请客与做客、待客准备、生日晚会和跨文化邻里交流
meta.courseModel: 三次课：饭馆请客与邀请 → 待客准备与问题解决 → 生日晚会与英国新邻居文化交流
meta.sourceTextPolicy: 教材中文、拼音、词汇英文释义与语法例句以L13文档为准；“请客”的英文按用户确认使用 stand treat；课文四英文译文、教学标题、题目、场景与任务明确标为教学扩展。

pedagogy.speakingParticipation: 最终任务可以使用真实或虚构的新邻居信息；每位学生必须有有效发言，不要求上传录音。
pedagogy.cultureFactPolicy: 文化表达允许多元答案，不把单一国家或家庭习惯设为唯一标准答案。

1.title: 饭馆请客与生日邀请
1.subtitle: 三位同事在饭馆点菜，并把一次饭局连接到下一次做客邀请。

steps.title: 看菜单，比较南北方菜
steps.talkHint: 看桌上的菜单、鱼和三位正在商量点菜的同事。
steps.prompt: 今天谁请客？他们在比较什么？
steps.promptPinyin: Jīntiān shéi qǐngkè? Tāmen zài bǐjiào shénme?
steps.promptEn: Who is treating today, and what are they comparing?
steps.sentence: 杨同乐请客，大家比较南方菜和北方菜的不同做法。

sampleAnswers.hanzi: 今天杨同乐请客。
sampleAnswers.pinyin: Jīntiān Yáng Tónglè qǐngkè.

sampleAnswers.hanzi: 南方菜和北方菜的做法不同。
sampleAnswers.pinyin: Nánfāng cài hé běifāng cài de zuòfǎ bù tóng.
sampleAnswers.english: Southern and northern dishes are made differently.

steps.title: 控制菜量，发出邀请
steps.talkHint: 看已点的菜、三个人的表情和王一雪正在说话的邀请手势。
steps.prompt: 他们为什么不再多点菜？王一雪又邀请大家做什么？
steps.promptPinyin: Tāmen wèishénme bú zài duō diǎn cài? Wáng Yīxuě yòu yāoqǐng dàjiā zuò shénme?
steps.promptEn: Why do they stop ordering, and what does Wang Yixue invite everyone to do?
steps.sentence: 三个人不点太多；有时间的话，就去王一雪家做客。

sampleAnswers.hanzi: 咱们就三个人，别点那么多。
sampleAnswers.pinyin: Zánmen jiù sān gè rén, bié diǎn nàme duō.
sampleAnswers.english: There are only three of us, so do not order too much.

sampleAnswers.hanzi: 有时间的话，就来我家做客。
sampleAnswers.pinyin: Yǒu shíjiān dehuà, jiù lái wǒ jiā zuòkè.
sampleAnswers.english: If you have time, come to my home.

2.title: 在家准备接待新邻居
2.subtitle: 主人检查饮料、酒、冰箱和音乐，为客人到来调整环境。

steps.title: 检查客人用品
steps.talkHint: 看冰箱里的饮料和酒，以及正在一起检查准备的夫妻。
steps.prompt: 刘明把什么放进冰箱了？为什么？
steps.promptPinyin: Liú Míng bǎ shénme fàngjìn bīngxiāng le? Wèishénme?
steps.promptEn: What did Liu Ming put into the fridge, and why?
steps.sentence: 刘明把饮料和酒放进冰箱，让王一雪放心。

sampleAnswers.hanzi: 他们在等新邻居来做客。
sampleAnswers.pinyin: Tāmen zài děng xīn línjū lái zuòkè.
sampleAnswers.english: They are waiting for the new neighbors.

sampleAnswers.hanzi: 刘明把饮料和酒放进冰箱了。
sampleAnswers.pinyin: Liú Míng bǎ yǐnliào hé jiǔ fàngjìn bīngxiāng le.
sampleAnswers.english: Liu Ming put the drinks and wine into the fridge.

steps.title: 调整音乐，等客人
steps.talkHint: 看音箱、音量图标和门边准备迎接客人的主人。
steps.prompt: 音乐有什么问题？他们接下来要做什么？
steps.promptPinyin: Yīnyuè yǒu shénme wèntí? Tāmen jiēxiàlái yào zuò shénme?
steps.promptEn: What is wrong with the music, and what will they do next?
steps.sentence: 刘明把声音关小一点儿，然后他们等客人来。

sampleAnswers.hanzi: 音乐的声音太大了。
sampleAnswers.pinyin: Yīnyuè de shēngyīn tài dà le.

sampleAnswers.hanzi: 他们准备好了，就等客人来。
sampleAnswers.pinyin: Tāmen zhǔnbèi hǎo le, jiù děng kèrén lái.
sampleAnswers.english: They are ready and are waiting for the guests.

3.title: 生日晚会与合适的礼物
3.subtitle: 客人送出适合小明兴趣的礼物，大家一起吃蛋糕、聊天儿。

steps.title: 欢迎客人，打开礼物
steps.talkHint: 看生日蛋糕、礼物、画板和画笔。
steps.prompt: 这是什么晚会？礼物为什么适合小明？
steps.promptPinyin: Zhè shì shénme wǎnhuì? Lǐwù wèishénme shìhé Xiǎomíng?
steps.promptEn: What party is this, and why does the gift suit Xiaoming?
steps.sentence: 生日晚会上，杨同乐送给想做画家的小明画板和画笔。

sampleAnswers.pinyin: Dàjiā lái cānjiā Xiǎomíng de shēngrì wǎnhuì.
sampleAnswers.english: Everyone comes to Xiaoming’s birthday party.

sampleAnswers.hanzi: 小明喜欢画画，想做一名画家。
sampleAnswers.pinyin: Xiǎomíng xǐhuan huàhuà, xiǎng zuò yì míng huàjiā.
sampleAnswers.english: Xiaoming likes drawing and wants to be a painter.

steps.title: 拿盘子，吃蛋糕聊天儿
steps.talkHint: 看主人拿来的盘子和围着蛋糕聊天儿的客人。
steps.prompt: 王一雪把什么拿过来？大家同时做哪两件事？
steps.promptPinyin: Wáng Yīxuě bǎ shénme ná guòlai? Dàjiā tóngshí zuò nǎ liǎng jiàn shì?
steps.promptEn: What does Wang Yixue bring, and which two things do they do together?
steps.sentence: 王一雪把盘子拿过来，大家一边吃蛋糕，一边聊天儿。

sampleAnswers.hanzi: 桌上有蛋糕和盘子。
sampleAnswers.pinyin: Zhuō shang yǒu dàngāo hé pánzi.
sampleAnswers.english: There is cake and there are plates on the table.

sampleAnswers.pinyin: Dàjiā yìbiān chī dàngāo, yìbiān liáotiānr.

4.title: 英国新邻居与文化交流
4.subtitle: 日记把两次互相做客、旅行地图和学习中文连成一个完整故事。

steps.title: 喝英国红茶，看旅行地图
steps.talkHint: 看英国夫妻、红茶和有很多红点的世界地图。
steps.prompt: 新邻居来自哪里？地图上的红点表示什么？
steps.promptPinyin: Xīn línjū láizì nǎlǐ? Dìtú shang de hóng diǎn biǎoshì shénme?

steps.sentence: 来自英国的夫妻用世界地图介绍他们去过的地方。

grammar.title: 假设复句“……的话，就……”
grammar.scene: 先比较“有时间”和“来做客”之间的条件与结果。
grammar.structure: 条件 + 的话，就 + 结果
grammar.explanation: “的话”放在假设条件后面，“就”引出条件成立时的结果。

examples.hanzi: 你喜欢南方菜的话，我们就点鱼。

grammar.title: “把”字句（四）：趋向或状态补语
grammar.titleEn: 把 sentences with directional or state complements
grammar.scene: 观察饮料、声音和盘子怎样从原来的位置或状态发生变化。
grammar.structure: 主语 + 把 + 宾语 + 动词 + 趋向补语 / 得 + 状态补语
grammar.explanation: 用“把”把受影响的事物提前，再说明它被移动到哪里或变成什么状态。

texts.title: 饭馆请客与做客邀请
texts.setting: 在饭馆，杨同乐请同事吃饭。

lines.speaker: 杨同乐
lines.hanzi: 今天我请客，你们想吃什么就点什么！
lines.pinyin: Jīntiān wǒ qǐngkè, nǐmen xiǎng chī shénme jiù diǎn shénme!
lines.english: Today is my treat, order whatever you feel like eating!

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 那我就不客气了。听说这家饭馆的鱼做得很特别？
lines.pinyin: Nà wǒ jiù bú kèqi le. Tīngshuō zhè jiā fànguǎn de yú zuò de hěn tèbié?
lines.english: Then I won't stand on ceremony. I heard the fish at this restaurant is prepared in a very special way?

lines.speaker: 杨同乐
lines.hanzi: 对，南方菜跟你们北方菜的做法不同。除了鱼，你们还想吃什么？
lines.pinyin: Duì, nánfāng cài gēn nǐmen běifāng cài de zuòfǎ bù tóng. Chúle yú, nǐmen hái xiǎng chī shénme?
lines.english: Right, southern cuisine is cooked differently from your northern dishes. Besides fish, what else would you like to eat?

lines.speaker: 同事
lines.hanzi: 我不常吃南方菜，还是你决定吧。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ bù cháng chī nánfāng cài, háishì nǐ juédìng ba.
lines.english: I don't eat southern food often, so you'd better decide.

lines.speaker: 杨同乐
lines.hanzi: 好，那再加一个鸡肉，一个……
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, nà zài jiā yí gè jīròu, yí gè...
lines.english: Alright, then let's add a chicken dish, a...

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 咱们就三个人，别点那么多。
lines.pinyin: Zánmen jiù sān gè rén, bié diǎn nàme duō.
lines.english: There are only three of us, don't order too much.

lines.speaker: 杨同乐
lines.hanzi: 好，那先来这几个菜。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, nà xiān lái zhè jǐ gè cài.
lines.english: Okay, let's start with these dishes first.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 对了，下周我儿子过生日，你们有时间的话，就来我家做客，我给你们做北京菜。
lines.pinyin: Duì le, xià zhōu wǒ érzi guò shēngrì, nǐmen yǒu shíjiān dehuà, jiù lái wǒ jiā zuòkè, wǒ gěi nǐmen zuò Běijīng cài.
lines.english: By the way, it's my son's birthday next week. If you have time, come over to my place and I'll cook Beijing cuisine for you.

texts.title: 准备接待新邻居
texts.setting: 在家里，王一雪和刘明为生日会做准备。

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 第一次请新邻居来做客，总是担心有什么没准备好。
lines.pinyin: Dì-yī cì qǐng xīn línjū lái zuòkè, zǒngshì dānxīn yǒu shénme méi zhǔnbèi hǎo.
lines.english: Inviting our new neighbors over for the first time, I'm always worried something might not be well prepared.

lines.speaker: 刘明
lines.hanzi: 放心吧，我帮你看了，都已经准备好了。
lines.pinyin: Fàngxīn ba, wǒ bāng nǐ kàn le, dōu yǐjīng zhǔnbèi hǎo le.
lines.english: Don't worry, I checked for you and everything is ready.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 我记得刚才已经把饮料拿出来了，怎么不见了？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ jìde gāngcái yǐjīng bǎ yǐnliào ná chūlai le, zěnme bú jiàn le?
lines.english: I remember I already took out the drinks just now, how come they're gone?

lines.speaker: 刘明
lines.hanzi: 我把饮料和酒都放进冰箱里了，客人来了再拿出来。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ yǐnliào hé jiǔ dōu fàngjìn bīngxiāng li le, kèrén lái le zài ná chūlai.
lines.english: I put the drinks and alcohol into the fridge; we can take them out when the guests arrive.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 音乐的声音合适吗？
lines.pinyin: Yīnyuè de shēngyīn héshì ma?
lines.english: Is the volume of the music appropriate?

lines.speaker: 刘明
lines.hanzi: 你把声音开得太大了，我去关小一点儿。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ bǎ shēngyīn kāi de tài dà le, wǒ qù guān xiǎo yìdiǎnr.
lines.english: You turned the volume up too loud; I'll go turn it down a bit.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 好，那我们就等客人来吧。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, nà wǒmen jiù děng kèrén lái ba.
lines.english: Okay, then let's just wait for the guests to arrive.

texts.title: 生日晚会与礼物
texts.setting: 在家里，王一雪和刘明办生日会。

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 谢谢你们来参加我儿子的生日晚会，希望大家今晚玩得开心。
lines.pinyin: Xièxie nǐmen lái cānjiā wǒ érzi de shēngrì wǎnhuì, xīwàng dàjiā jīnwǎn wán de kāixīn.
lines.english: Thank you for coming to my son's birthday party; I hope everyone has fun tonight.

lines.speaker: 杨同乐
lines.hanzi: 小明，生日快乐！我准备了一个小礼物，希望你喜欢！
lines.pinyin: Xiǎomíng, shēngrì kuàilè! Wǒ zhǔnbèi le yí gè xiǎo lǐwù, xīwàng nǐ xǐhuan!
lines.english: Xiaoming, happy birthday! I prepared a small gift, hope you like it!

lines.speaker: 刘小明
lines.hanzi: 谢谢您，我可以打开吗？
lines.pinyin: Xièxie nín, wǒ kěyǐ dǎkāi ma?
lines.english: Thank you, may I open it?

lines.speaker: 杨同乐
lines.hanzi: 当然可以，你妈妈说你跟姐姐一样，都喜欢画画，对吗？
lines.pinyin: Dāngrán kěyǐ, nǐ māma shuō nǐ gēn jiějie yíyàng, dōu xǐhuan huàhuà, duì ma?
lines.english: Of course. Your mom said you like drawing just like your sister, right?

lines.speaker: 刘小明
lines.hanzi: 对，我想做一名画家。啊！画板和画笔，这正是我需要的。我太喜欢了。
lines.pinyin: Duì, wǒ xiǎng zuò yì míng huàjiā. À! Huàbǎn hé huàbǐ, zhè zhèng shì wǒ xūyào de. Wǒ tài xǐhuan le.
lines.english: Yes, I want to become a painter. Ah! A drawing board and paintbrushes, this is exactly what I needed. I love it so much.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 我去把盘子拿过来，咱们一边吃蛋糕，一边聊天儿吧。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ qù bǎ pánzi ná guòlai, zánmen yìbiān chī dàngāo, yìbiān liáotiānr ba.
lines.english: I'll go bring over the plates, let's eat cake and chat at the same time.

texts.title: 英国新邻居日记
texts.author: 王一雪
texts.setting: 在家里，王一雪在写日记。
texts.translationPolicy: 教材文档未提供课文四英文译文；english 字段为教学扩展。

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 我的新邻居是来自英国的夫妻。上周我去他们家做客了。他们做了很多好吃的，还准备了英国的红茶。那天我跟他们一边喝红茶，一边聊天儿，直到十二点多才回家。他们年轻的时候喜欢旅游，他家有一张世界地图，上面每一个红点都是他们去过的地方。后来，他们感到东方的文化很特别，就开始学习中文。今天是小明的生日，我请他们到我家玩，来看看中国人的家，也尝尝中国菜。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ de xīn línjū shì láizì Yīngguó de fūqī. Shàng zhōu wǒ qù tāmen jiā zuòkè le. Tāmen zuòle hěn duō hǎochī de, hái zhǔnbèi le Yīngguó de hóngchá. Nà tiān wǒ gēn tāmen yìbiān hē hóngchá, yìbiān liáotiānr, zhídào shí'èr diǎn duō cái huí jiā. Tāmen niánqīng de shíhou xǐhuan lǚyóu, tā jiā yǒu yì zhāng shìjiè dìtú, shàngmiàn měi yí gè hóng diǎn dōu shì tāmen qùguo de dìfang. Hòulái, tāmen gǎndào dōngfāng de wénhuà hěn tèbié, jiù kāishǐ xuéxí Zhōngwén. Jīntiān shì Xiǎomíng de shēngrì, wǒ qǐng tāmen dào wǒ jiā wán, lái kànkan Zhōngguórén de jiā, yě chángchang Zhōngguócài.
lines.english: My new neighbors are a married couple from the UK. Last week I visited their home. They made lots of delicious food and prepared British tea. We drank tea and chatted until after midnight. They loved travelling when they were young; every red dot on their world map marks a place they visited. Later they found Eastern culture special and began learning Chinese. Today is Xiaoming’s birthday, so I invited them to see a Chinese home and taste Chinese food.

C.prompt_cn: Classroom Presentation: Welcome Our New Neighbor
C.prompt_en: Give a 1–2 minute in-class presentation or exchange. No audio upload is required.
presentationPlan: Bring the A menu/invitation, B preparation card and one privacy-safe map, hometown or culture image.
Answer six points: who the neighbor is, invitation, menu, preparation, one problem/solution, and cultural activities.
Use at least eight L13 words plus one ……的话，就…… sentence, one 把 sentence with a complement and one 一边……一边…… sentence.
Groups may share visual materials and take host/guest roles, but every student must speak for a meaningful turn. Present for 1–2 minutes. No audio upload is required.
C.classroomNote: 错题和薄弱点默认折叠，学生选择后再展开。

focus: 待客准备与把字句补语

recommendationRules.then: 重做对应A/B/C五阶段预习并复习错词。
用A的邀请卡和B的准备卡重新完成一次1分钟欢迎新邻居表达。
